defect.snippet: where: { id: postId, topics: { archived: false } },

locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code loads and saves the post's topic relation through the ORM? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: addTopics loads the post with a where filter on the relation (topics.archived = false), so post.topics contains only active topics. save() on a ManyToMany treats the in-memory array as the full set and deletes join rows not present, so every archived-topic link on the post is silently removed from post_topics. Also, a post with only archived topics (or none) fails the inner join and yields NotFoundError. Load the full relation and filter in memory, or use the relation query builder's add().

choiceQuestions.prompt: Two requests call addTopics on the same post concurrently. How are they ordered?
choices: They run in parallel and the last save wins
The second fails immediately with an optimistic-lock version error
The pessimistic_write lock on the posts row makes the second wait until the first transaction commits
choiceQuestions.explanation: findOne takes a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on posts inside the transaction, so the second request blocks until the first commits, then reads the updated state. VersionColumn is incremented on save but no version is compared at load, so there is no immediate optimistic failure, and a single row lock does not deadlock.

choiceQuestions.prompt: A caller passes slugs ["Rust", " rust ", ""]. Which slugs are looked up?
choiceQuestions.explanation: Each slug is trimmed and lowercased, a Set removes the duplicate "rust", and filter(Boolean) drops the empty string, leaving ["rust"].

choiceQuestions.prompt: In addTopics, the topic-count limit is checked after topics are pushed but before save. If it throws, what is persisted?
choices: The new topics up to the limit
Nothing; the error rolls back the transaction before save runs
All new topics, since push already wrote them
Only the version bump on posts
choiceQuestions.explanation: Pushing onto post.topics only changes the in-memory entity; nothing is written until save. Throwing inside ds.transaction rolls back and releases the lock, so nothing changes, including the version column.
